independent_computation.step_1_scenario_reading: The scenario id 'syndra_custom_order_120' pins the Syndra splinters option at its documented maximum, 120 (the wiki's own cap: 'stacking up to 120 times'; the cached audit records the option domain as 0-120). 120 >= 60, so the W Transcendent bonus is ACTIVE in this fight, and 120 >= 100/80/40 so every other Transcendent bonus is live too.
independent_computation.step_2_type_inventory: Syndra's kit, per the cached wiki text, emits exactly one non-magic damage instance. Q ('dealing magic damage'), E ('deals magic damage'), R ('each dealing magic damage upon hit') and the W recast base ('dealing magic damage') are all MAGIC_DAMAGE at the slot level. The single true-damage instance in the entire kit is the W Transcendent bonus at >= 60 splinters.
independent_computation.step_3_row_decode: Verified that the cached 'Bonus True Damage' leveling row is exactly 12% + 2% per 100 AP OF THE W MAGIC PACKET, i.e. bonus_true = (0.12 + 0.02*AP/100) * (base_W + 0.65*AP), with base_W = [70,100,130,160,190] by rank. Flat term 0.12*base = [8.4, 12.0, 15.6, 19.2, 22.8] -- matches the cached row 5/5. AP coefficient 0.12*65 + 0.02*base = [9.2, 9.8, 10.4, 11.0, 11.6] -- matches the cached row 5/5. This 10-of-10 match confirms the row is a genuine separate TRUE packet riding on the magic packet, and the sibling row 'Total Mixed Damage' (= magic + true, e.g. 78.4 = 70 + 8.4) confirms the W recast is authored as two instances of two different damage types, not one.
independent_computation.step_4_worked_number: Worked example, W rank 5, 500 AP before Transcendence: total AP = 500 * 1.15 = 575 (P at 120 splinters). W magic = 190 + 0.65*575 = 563.75. Bonus true = (0.12 + 0.02*575/100) * 563.75 = 0.235 * 563.75 = 132.48. Cross-check against the wiki row form 22.8 + 11.6%AP + 1.3%AP^2/100 = 22.8 + 66.70 + 42.98 = 132.48. Identical. Under docs/math-foundations.md Section 2.1 the magic packet is then multiplied by 100/(100+MR) while the true packet is not -- so the damage_type label is load-bearing on the number, not cosmetic.
independent_computation.step_5_conclusion: At 120 splinters a Syndra manual-target fight that casts W MUST contain exactly one damage event typed 'true' (the W Transcendent bonus) and no others, since no ordinary SR AP item in the cache adds a true-damage instance. Relabelling that event 'magic' both contradicts the wiki text verbatim ('bonus true damage') and understates it by the 100/(100+MR) mitigation factor. Nothing in the cached data converts Syndra's true damage into magic damage.

residual_uncertainty.what_i_could_not_verify: The event INDEX. The scenario definition and the golden baseline live under tests/ and scripts/, which this runbook forbids me to read, so I cannot prove that damage_events[8] is the W bonus rather than some other event. Syndra's modeled slots are P/Q/Q2/W/E/R (data/champion-audit/batch-6.json) and R emits one event per sphere (r_spheres, up to 3 conjured + 4 grabbed), so index 8 could in principle land on an R sphere.
residual_uncertainty.the_competing_hypothesis: If the change under test reordered damage_events (the scenario name points at the custom cast_order path; data/worklists/f2-task.md documents a rotation/cast_order engine whose gates say 'cast orders change fight totals ... THIS IS EXPECTED AND DESIRED'), then index 8 could simply be a different event now, and 'magic' would be an artifact of a legitimate shuffle rather than a mistyping.
residual_uncertainty.why_i_still_ruled_old_value_correct: The only wiki-adjudicable fact bearing on this leaf is that Syndra's W bonus is TRUE damage and that it is live at 120 splinters. The scenario was deliberately pinned at the splinter value where that bonus exists; a fight in that state owes exactly one 'true' event, and the observed change removes a 'true' label without any cached evidence that a true instance should not exist. Absent a compensating magic->true flip at a neighbouring index (which I cannot see), 'magic' at this path is a downgrade of a wiki-mandated true instance. If the reviewer can confirm that the same diff contains a mirrored magic->true flip at damage_events[9] (or that the W true event survives at another index), this verdict should be re-read as new_value_correct -- that is the single discriminating check I was unable to run.

asides: Cached-data nit, unrelated to this leaf: the third modifier on Syndra's W 'Bonus True Damage' and 'Total Mixed Damage' rows is cached as 1.14 %AP for every rank. The quadratic term implied by the wiki text is 0.02 * 65% = 1.3 %AP^2 per 100 AP, and 1.3 is what reproduces the row's own totals exactly (see step_4). The 1.14 looks like a wiki/parser artifact. It affects magnitude, not damage type.

The same rows carry the unit string '  2' (a mangled superscript-2 for the AP-squared term) -- another sign this row survives the modifier parser only partially, consistent with the CLAUDE.md 'known-degraded wiki parses' class.
